name: switchbot
description: Control SwitchBot smart-home devices from Gemini CLI via MCP (31 tools, policy-based safety gates)

settings.name: SwitchBot Token
settings.description: Your SwitchBot Open API token (required). Get it from the SwitchBot app: Profile → Preferences → Developer Options → Open API. If you previously ran `switchbot auth login`, the token is already stored in ~/.switchbot/config.json — you can copy it from there.

settings.name: SwitchBot Secret
settings.description: Your SwitchBot Open API secret (required, shown alongside the token in Developer Options). Same location as above — also stored in ~/.switchbot/config.json if you used `switchbot auth login`.
